name: TestDesk
description: Find, plan, run, and diagnose project tests across Go, .NET, Vitest, Jest, Cargo, Playwright, pytest, Maven, Gradle, and Cypress from any MCP host.
supportedPlatforms: Linux amd64 (CI build and archive checks; manual GUI verification pending)
macOS arm64 (CI desktop smoke; manual real-device feedback requested)
macOS amd64 (CI desktop smoke; manual real-device feedback requested)
privacy: TestDesk runs locally over stdio JSON-RPC and communicates with the desktop owner on loopback. Provider commands execute configured local test tools with user permissions. No cloud relay, telemetry, or credential collection is built in.
suggestedPrompts: Use TestDesk to inspect available providers and test status without running tests.
Discover and run tests matching this module, then wait for completion.
Inspect bounded diagnostics for the latest failing run and rerun failed tests after fixing.
